bio: The location in the side wing of the modern Klinik Gut private hospital may be a little unusual, but the food here is excellent… thanks to Sebastian Titz (previously at Verve by Sven in Bad Ragaz), who cooks up regional and seasonal cuisine that cuts to the chase. Lunch is the main affair here: dish of the day, a small à la carte selection and set menus (fish/meat or vegetarian), as well as a weekly special and Our House Speciality. A tasting menu is served on Thursday evenings. The decor is trendy and minimalist in style, with an open kitchen; the view of the mountains and the surrounding area is fabulous – tables on the terrace are understandably coveted....
